question: For contribution to which sport/game did BC Suresh receive the Dhyan Chand Award (lifetime achievement) for the year 2022?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Kabaddi.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Shri B.C Suresh received the Dhyan Chand Award for his contribution to the sport of **Kabaddi.**
 
• The **Dhyan Chand Award** for Lifetime achievement in Sports and Games is an award given by the Government of India to honour the** lifetime achievements of sportspeople.**
 
• The award is named after Dhyan Chand, a** legendary Indian hockey player **who won three **Olympic gold medals for India in 1928, 1932, and 1936.**
 
• The award was instituted in** 2002 **to honour those sportspersons who have contributed to the promotion of sports even after their retirement from active sporting career.
 
• Shri B.C Suresh received the Dhyan Chand Award for Lifetime achievement in **Sports and Games in 2022.**

**​** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Dhyan Chand Award:

 
 
• The Dhyan Chand Award is the **highest award for lifetime achievement in sports and games** in India. Officially, it is also referred to as the **"Dhyan Chand Award for Lifetime Achievement in Sports and Games".**
 
• The award is named after one of the** greatest Hockey Players of India, Dhyan Chand. **Chand was renowned for his extraordinary goal-scoring feats, in addition to his three Olympic gold medals in field hockey, which led to his being widely considered to be the greatest player of all time.
 
• This prestigious **award was introduced in 2002.** The first recipients were **Shahuraj Birajdar (Boxing), Ashok Diwan (Hockey), and Aparna Ghosh (Basketball)**.
 
• Typically, the award is conferred upon **not more than three sportspersons in a single year, **although **exceptions** have been made in the years **2003, 2012-2013, and 2018-2020**, when more recipients were awarded.
 
• The award comprises **a statuette, a certificate, a ceremonial dress, and a cash prize**. It serves not just to honour recipients but also to promote the pursuit of excellence in sports across the nation.
